import { Controller, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import {
  EventPattern,
  MicroserviceOptions,
  Payload,
  Transport,
} from '@nestjs/microservices';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Entity, PrimaryColumn, Repository } from 'typeorm';

@Entity('stripe_payment')
class StripePaymentEntity {
  @PrimaryColumn()
  declare id: string;
}

@Controller()
class StripeEventsController {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(StripePaymentEntity)
    private readonly payments: Repository<StripePaymentEntity>,
  ) {}

  // D0_CASE:microservices-consumer-only-stripe
  @EventPattern('stripe.payment_succeeded')
  async paymentSucceeded(@Payload() payload: { readonly id: string }): Promise<void> {
    await this.payments.save({ id: payload.id });
  }
}

@Module({ controllers: [StripeEventsController] })
class StripeConsumerModule {}

void NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(StripeConsumerModule, {
  transport: Transport.RMQ,
});

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 Nest microservices fixture must never execute: consumer-only');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
